jobs.tierReason: train 9 tin 1 Opus blocker: launchd restart must match the launchd board and run once
jobs.prompt:
FILE ACCESS: your declared outputs are readable. Opus found a blocker in train 9 tin 1 (tools/server-restart.mjs around the launchd branch ~893): the branch is taken for EVERY old-version board work item (registry or discovered) when the plist exists and `launchctl print` reports running with any pid. It never checks that the record is the launchd board, and it can kickstart more than once per update. Consequences: a stray pre-1.167.34 board in board.json gets the launchd job kickstarted, pollNewVersion polls the stray port and reports failed; registry + discovered board items double-kickstart and kill the just-updated board; a terminal board on another port gets its 'press Ctrl-C' guidance replaced by a launchd restart.

Fix:
1. Import readBoardIdentity from './board-keepalive.mjs' (fs and boardFile are already available; boardPath is computed in restartRegisteredServers). Compute the keep-up identity once per call: `const identity = await readBoardIdentity({ dir: path.dirname(boardPath), fs });`.
2. In the launchd branch, parse the pid from `launchctl print` into a number (not just a regex existence check). Treat the work item as the launchd board only when `(identity && identity.port === record.port) || launchdPid === record.pid`. Only then run the launchd path; every other board item falls through to the existing terminal/isAutoRestartable/pid-ownership/manual/discovery logic exactly as before.
3. Add a per-call `launchdKicked` flag. Run kickstart at most once. If a second work item is also identified as the launchd board after a kick, skip it (continue) instead of restarting it again or falling through to a manual restart. A stray/non-launchd board must still take the manual or terminal path.
4. Keep the unloaded-job busy-port skip and the remote path as they are. Keep the kickstart + pollNewVersion + status semantics.
5. Tests in tests/one-board-owner.test.mjs:
   - stray record on a port different from the keep-up identity (identity file present, launchd loaded, launchd pid different from record.pid): zero kickstart calls; the old manual or terminal path runs as before (assert kill/spawn or the terminal guidance).
   - registry record + a discovered board entry (simulate via the existing execFileImpl/discovery seams): exactly one kickstart call, no manual restart of the launchd board, and the just-updated board is not killed by a second item.
   - launchd board identified by a matching identity port but a stale record pid: still kickstarted once.
   - Keep every existing launchd test green.

Verify: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/one-board-owner.test.mjs tests/board-keepalive.test.mjs tests/restart-any-server.test.mjs tests/server-restart-round3.test.mjs -> all pass. Do not start a real board; use stubs/temp dirs.
